svg.title: The public API of Typed Linear Algebra
svg.desc: The public API of the fcarouge namespace. The typed_matrix class template composes a backend matrix with row and column index types that give each element its type. Concepts constrain it and its operations, and the element_caster and multiplies customization points convert and multiply its elements. Free functions and operators operate on it, aliases and functions make row and column vectors, the _i literal indexes it at compile time, and standard library specializations format it, find a common type, and bind its elements. A user supplied plug-in provides the backend matrix and specializes the customization points for strong element types.
